pins.definition: The season between summer and winter, when temperatures cool and leaves fall.
The season of the year between summer and winter.
The season of the year between summer and winter, when leaves fall and the weather grows colder.

situation: A man in an old brown coat walks down a suburban sidewalk as a dense cascade of amber and scarlet leaves detaches from a massive oak above him, filling the air.
subject: the falling leaves and the season
brief: A lone figure in a thick coat walks beneath a towering tree whose canopy is half-bare, with crisp orange and red leaves mid-air all around him against a cool, pale sky. The ground at his feet is already a thick carpet of fallen foliage, showing the transition of the season in sharp flat planes of color.
